Brief: Tell me about the Hubble Space Telescope and what it has discovered. — about Galaxy

1. Beginning in the 1990s, the Hubble Space Telescope yielded improved observations.
2. Improved technology in detecting the spectra invisible to humans (radio telescopes, infrared cameras, and x-ray telescopes) allows detection of other galaxies that are not detected by Hubble.
3. A 2016 study published in The Astrophysical Journal, led by Christopher Conselice of the University of Nottingham, analyzed many sources of data to estimate that the observable universe (up to z=8) contained at least two trillion (2×1012) galaxies, a factor of 10 more than are directly observed in Hubble images.
